dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses ORCA-specific copybooks (CPCOMMONDAT2.INC, CPSYSKANRI.INC, CPTENSU.INC, etc.) and ORCA subprogram calls (ORCSJOB).

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system - monthly drug/medical supply usage statistics report generation
purpose.summary: This program generates a monthly statistical report of drug and medical supply usage by department/category (診療科別医薬品使用量統計（月報）). It reads from a statistics indexed file (TOKEI-FILE), processes parameters passed via COMMAND-PARAM, formats date/title information, and produces printed output through the ORCA print management subsystem.

notable_features: 22 CALL statements to ORCA subprograms (ORCSJOB, etc.)
INDEXED file with DYNAMIC access mode
UNSTRING used to parse comma-delimited COMMAND-PARAM
OCCURS tables for department and item data
Japanese text in comments and data (EUC-JP/latin-1 decoded)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: Source file contains Japanese text encoded in EUC-JP, decoded as latin-1 resulting in mojibake in the archived form. The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Truncated at 16000 chars but enough structure is visible to classify confidently. Max line length 74 with 5 lines over 72 suggests mostly fixed-format with minor overruns.
